name: concept-2
purpose: M1 한 컷 2차. 1차(concept.json)는 구도는 맞았으나 성벽이 사람 2배(목표 2.5), 문루 3.6배(목표 4.5)로 낮고, 시점이 40° 보다 위에서 봤고, 요청에 없는 소품이 많았다. 숫자는 그대로, 강조 순서만 바꿨다 (마크 R13 판정).
prompt: The attached images are STYLE references only (classic Korean MMORPG pixel art). Study their color feel; do not copy any building or character from them. THREE THINGS MATTER MOST IN THIS IMAGE, check them before anything else: (1) SCALE — an adult person is exactly 2 units tall; the stone castle wall at the back is 5 units tall = TWO AND A HALF PEOPLE stacked, and the gate pavilion roof on top of the wall reaches 9 units = FOUR AND A HALF PEOPLE; the houses' roof ridges are 4 units = TWO people. If the wall looks only twice a person's height, it is wrong. (2) CAMERA — fixed camera to the SOUTH, tilted exactly 40 degrees downward (NOT top-down: walls must show clearly, roughly as much wall as roof is visible on the front houses), strict ORTHOGRAPHIC projection, back objects the same scale as front objects. (3) NO PROPS — no trees, fences, barrels, carts, banners, flowers, rocks, wells, signs. Only the nine buildings, the ground, and four people. Morning light from the UPPER LEFT, flat sky color #b9d4e6, no fog, no cast shadows. Everything is built from simple blocky 3D primitives (boxes, triangular-prism roofs, 4-sided pyramid roofs, thin cylinder posts, flat planes) covered in crisp pixel-art textures — a low-poly blockout with pixel textures, NOT a painting. Layout, front (south) to back (north): FRONT ROW — five long single-story houses side by side with 2 units of gap, each 9 units wide, 3 deep, earth walls 2.5 tall, gray roof-tile gable roofs with the ridge at 4.0, eaves overhanging 0.5, four wooden posts at the corners, three doors on the south face (2.5 tall, 1.25 wide) spaced 3 units apart with one small window between doors, a plain sandy yard 2 units deep in front. The five houses differ ONLY by door color, left to right: navy #2f4f7a, moss green #4a5d3a, blue-violet #4b5f9e, navy #2f4f7a with small brass coin pattern #d8b25c, deep teal #1f5f4f (the fifth house is shorter: 6 wide, two doors). MIDDLE — a stone-paved plaza 15 by 9 units with two stone lanterns (2.5 tall) flanking a dirt road that leads north to the castle gate; a dirt road also runs south to the houses. LEFT of the plaza — a teahouse 6 by 5 units, same wall and roof as the houses, a wooden door with a cream bamboo blind, and a hemp-cloth awning (2.2 high, 2.5 deep) over five standing spots in front. RIGHT of the plaza — the chief's house, a little larger: 5 by 4, walls 3.0 tall, 4-sided pyramid tile roof to 5.0, navy door with gold knocker. BACK — the stone castle wall 21 units wide and 5 tall (two and a half people) with battlements, a gate opening 2.5 wide and 3 tall in the middle with dark interior and two open wooden doors, a gate pavilion on top (earth walls 2 tall, pyramid tile roof reaching 9 units above ground — the highest point, four and a half people), and behind the wall the tile roof of one large hall rising to 7. Place four small pixel-art people (2 units tall, hanbok in various colors, 1px dark outlines): one standing right next to the castle wall so the wall height can be compared, one in front of a house next to a door, two in the plaza. Palette limited to these 32 colors only: #1b1a1f #3d3a44 #6f6d78 #a8a6ae #f4efe4 #d9d1bf #b7ab92 #f3d3b3 #d9a878 #a86f4a #6e4630 #8b5a2b #d8b25c #4a2c1a #4b5f9e #c96f3b #6b4a2f #4a5d3a #2f6b7a #9c3b2f #1f5f4f #7a3b52 #2f4f7a #a8541f #5b3a63 #8a7320 #2e4a2a #6f9a4a #a9c86a #5f8fbf #b9d4e6 #c94a3a. Textures are chunky pixels: each world unit is 32 texture pixels. No text, no UI, no name tags, no border. Landscape 16:9, 1920x1080 PNG.
after: 1차를 out/kit/concept-1.png 로 옮기고 2차를 out/kit/concept.png 로 저장. 팔레트 스냅 안 함. 재는 것: 성벽 옆에 세운 사람 키 대비 성벽(여장 위~밑) 2.3~2.7 배, 문루 꼭대기 4.0~5.0 배, 집 용마루 1.8~2.3 배. 셋 다 들면 받고, 하나라도 벗어나면 3차. 소품이 다시 나오면 비율이 맞아도 버린다.
